text:
maria: heads-up: customer demo blocked, sample-app in JSON mode sporadically fails schema validation. logs incoming.
aj: what's the trace?
maria: validator error: JSONDecodeError; raw_body: \"{\\\"cmd\\\": \\\"apply\\\", \\\"args\\\": [1,2,],}\" — looks like a trailing comma and the whole body is a string (double-encoded).
kai: double-encode smells like the retry wrapper doing JSON.stringify on replay. py kept the object; parity mismatch.
aj: our tests missed this because mocks normalized shapes. not covered.
ellie: repro steps for devs: 
ENV=dev DEBUG=devex:tooling node sample-app
# then from another terminal
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer expired' -d @prompt.json
This forces a 401 then a retry.
maria: immediate fix: update JS retry helper to preserve original toolArgs (do not stringify) and add an opt-in sanitizer SANITIZE_TOOL_OUTPUT that strips trailing commas only when parse fails. also add sample-app middleware to log raw incoming body on validation failure so customers get clear repro info.
aj: i'll open a PR with the fix + unit tests and changelog entry. ETA EOD.
kai: i'll add a parity integration (js + py) that simulates a 401 gateway then asserts the retried transport receives the identical object shape and preserves streaming vs non-streaming mode.
ellie: sanitizer must be opt-in and only run after parse failure to avoid mutating valid model output; document heuristic in README.
devrel-bot: created DEVEX-4723: \"jsonmode: retry double-encode + trailing-comma heuristic\" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-4723
maria: once PR lands run onboarding smoke suite against sample-app in JSON mode. fallback for demo is to switch to non-JSON mode.
aj: ping me on PR, i'll review fast. :thumbsup:
